starlink.notes: Terminals destroyed, customers affected, insurer clock starts.

nsc.notes: Not public attribution: the actor question is genuinely open.

ground_truth.notes: The one scenario where high hostile confidence is correct AND a confident actor attribution is wrong. Pass conditions are a conjunction: beliefs.hostile at or above 0.75 by the end, and per_actor mass split between hacktivist_injects and northern_fleet with neither above about 0.6 and neither below about 0.15. expected_attributed_actor is null throughout because there is no single right name — naming the claimant alone ignores the tasking question the second forensic report explicitly leaves open, and naming the fleet alone asserts direction that nothing in the record establishes. This is the scenario that catches a model which has learned to treat hostile probability and actor confidence as one number; storm_only catches the opposite error. counter_rpo is forbidden here, unlike in dazzle_then_denial: there is no space actor to close on, so a co-orbital response is a category error rather than a proportionality judgement. Note for the engine: the hacktivist_injects affiliation is normally drawn per run from env config; this devset file fixes it as russian_directed and the claim as truthful so the scenario is deterministic. The seats never see either fact.
